title: Embedding modes ablation (token_type_pe vs. token_type_nope vs. nope)
question: With input_ids held identical across modes at a fixed sequence length L, what do section-coupled position_ids and 16-d token_type_ids contribute to in-distribution convergence speed and sample efficiency compared to causal masking alone (nope)? (Zero-shot length generalisation across embedding modes is evaluated separately in `addition`.)
